reviews.author: Deb Whitford
reviews.text: Beautiful grass and trees...very clean park!  Campground is about 1/2 full right now before schools get out for Summer..  very peaceful 😉

reviews.author: Gina Steinmetz
reviews.text: I love this park. We have volunteered and camped here for 4 summers. The grounds show how hard the staff and volunteers put in to it. The head Ranger, Jose was always making everyone from guests to staff feel like they were his top priority. The parks has something for everybody. From lush, well groomed campsites, water access with beach and the famous Apple Capitol Loop trail that goes through it, you have it all. I really appreciated how clean and maintained the park was. Kudos for the best state park in the State of Washington!!!!! ( in my opinion:)

reviews.author: Bad Influence Adventures
reviews.text:
It's a really nice park, but...
Many of the sites have low hanging limbs that hit the roofs of 5th wheel trailers. Both loops need the limbs trimmed back to allow taller rigs to drive through without risking damage to ACs or the roof membrane.  Thankfully, our 5th wheel has a composite roof.

reviews.author: Leslie McGehee
reviews.text: I really liked this state park. It is fairly large & very well maintained & clean. We walked through the campground which looked very nice also. The Apple Capital Recreation Loop trail is right there if you want to get a good walk in. The beach area was lovely also. There is a bridge over the Wenatchee River where you can see it going into the Columbia River. Also, check out the gravel trail & you can see lots of nature there. Saw bald eagles & several ospreys. I'm a fan of Wenatchee in general, so I really enjoyed this park.

reviews.author: Rob Burkhart
reviews.text: So we have been on an epic road trip this summer. We are on day 65. We're just about to 15,000, MI. We've been left. Nevada went through Arizona, Utah, Montana, Canada, Alaska back down through Canada now in Washington state. While it's been an epic trip, I've got to say that this park has been one of the most amazing parts of it. Just a beautiful place. Tons of shade. Plenty of room between sites. Really really nice staff and rangers cannot say enough good about it.

reviews.title: Great community asset!
reviews.author: tw0fingers
reviews.text: We have camped here for a lot of years. The staffing levels have been cut over the years, but the staff there do an outstanding job. The maintenance program, (with the exception of the trees in the sites that constantly need trimming because in many cases, they scratch your RV), is good. Washrooms are immaculate and there's no litter around. It always seems safe, secure, and quiet. Great proximity to the Loop Trail and to Pybus Market. Thanks, PUD, for the great piece of property!

reviews.title: Best little known park around.
reviews.author: YuccaBC
reviews.text: Very busy campground, even midweek in October it was full! Despite the business, the park operator is only sporadically available to assist with check in. I'm not sure why the sprinklers were set to go at 10 am in the morning but it made it very difficult to pack up and not get soaked at the same time. It's a huge manicured campground located close to town, but not really walking distance either. Easy access to the Apple Capital Loop Trail is a definite plus. It allows you to bike to town if you choose.

reviews.title: Take it or leave it
reviews.text: Nice enough park, but it really depends what you want to do. We were there in late October. There were some campers and some people out for a stroll. It's really just a set of grassy fields. Most toilets were closed. We were more interested in nature so we went over the foot bridge to the nature reserve. Very pretty. Overall, not convinced it was worth paying for unless you enjoy urban camping.

reviews.title: In city gem
reviews.text: Clean park except for the Geese. Flat. Easy parking. Fire pits and tent pads in good shape. Aluminum picnic tables. Clean heated bathroom. Only 3 other rigs there. Along river in the city but not noisy.

reviews.title: Full hookups
reviews.text: Huge sites, clean location, and full hookups at the site we were at. Right in the middle of Wenatchee. Lots of open fields and walkways connect into the park. We are in our 40's and enjoyed the one night that we stayed.

reviews.title: Great State Park Campground
reviews.author: kjh36
reviews.text: Bike trail 11.3 mile loop. Beautiful! West side of the river parks. East side native brush and grass. Stay to the right of the trail ALWAYS. Be careful, wear helmets. Ducks, seagulls, osprey, kingfishers, mergansers, red wing black birds, bald eagles, crows, marmots, beaver, deer. Mulberries, blackberries in season. Cross two bridges via trail. One over the Columbia, one over the Wenatchee. Two trail spurs, if you don't want to do loop, that go to either Hydro Park (south) or Lincoln Rock Park (north).

reviews.title: Awesome Park
reviews.author: C. Johnson
reviews.text: This a a pretty park. Nice concrete pads or pull through sites that are level, sandy tent pad if needed. Sites are spaced nicely with lots of grass and trees. Nice paved trails around the park. We didn't go to the water access area. Lots of shopping and restaurants to choose from in East Wenatchee. Nice place for kids to ride bikes and walk dogs. Worth every penny to support maintaining our state parks to have nice places like this to camp!

reviews.title: Trailer Owner
reviews.author: Stacie
reviews.text: I love this park! The park could easily accommodate double the amount of sites, but it's perfect the way it is. The sites are all paved and have plenty of grass and strategically planted shade trees. Each site also has a square tent site. The loops are big enough that there's a large, open grassy area in the center. In addition to water activities, the access to the bike trail is great.

reviews.title: Rv Camping
reviews.author: Jason Plant
reviews.text: For three days we've been trying to book a site. No one has any. And every one of them does not know anything except there park.

reviews.title: Very Nice Spot
reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: We really enjoyed this state park. The sites are spacious and there are many trails to see the nearby rivers. The kids loved the playground. Yes the sites are pricey but it's a state park and all state parks around here are fairly expensive.

reviews.author: Cindy
reviews.text: I loved this park. The only reason I did t give it 5 stars is because I prefer camping among trees and this park doesn't have many. Even though you are so close to town, you still feel like your out a little ways when you are in the park. Easy access to the river(s). Well maintained and very clean.
